entries.text: I've eaten berries: my recorded nutrition is 8 and toxicity 0. I have one hazelnut sample, but its nutrition and toxicity remain unknown to me. Does anyone have personally tested findings about hazelnuts?
entries.note: Agree: "Does anyone have personally tested findings about hazelnuts?" closes a food report with an information request; no name, norm, invitation, valuation or absent person.

entries.text: My whole-root trial ran 8 rounds: exposed and carried roots each gained 9.205 decay, difference zero. No preservation benefit shown; water and contamination unmeasured. I have no hazelnut findings. Roots I ate gave nutrition 14, toxicity 0.
